theorem_A0.name: COMMON_LAYER_MIM_UNION_EQUIVALENCE_V1
theorem_A0.setup: Extend each layer I_{sigma,i} to the common vertex universe U=S_sigma union C_sigma by making survivor vertices of other layers isolated. Let I_sigma be the union of the three layer edge sets.
theorem_A0.cut_statement: For every cut A subset U, max_i mim_{I_{sigma,i}}(A) <= mim_{I_sigma}(A) <= sum_i mim_{I_{sigma,i}}(A) <= 3*max_i mim_{I_{sigma,i}}(A).
proof: Every induced matching M in one layer I_{sigma,i} remains induced in I_sigma: its endpoints lie in R_i union C_sigma, while every edge added by another layer has its survivor endpoint in R_j with j!=i and therefore cannot join two endpoints of M.
Let M be an induced matching of I_sigma across A. Every edge of M belongs uniquely to one layer according to its survivor endpoint. Partition M=M_1 disjoint_union M_2 disjoint_union M_3.
Each M_i remains an induced matching in I_{sigma,i}; hence |M_i|<=mim_{I_{sigma,i}}(A).
theorem_A0.decomposition_statement: For every common branch decomposition T, COMMON_LAYER_MIM(T) <= mim_{I_sigma}(T) <= 3*COMMON_LAYER_MIM(T).
theorem_A0.consequence: Existence of a q(|S|)-bounded common layout is equivalent up to a factor 3 to existence of a q(|S|)-bounded mim-width decomposition of the single incidence-union graph I_sigma, using the same decomposition tree.
theorem_A0.constructibility_consequence: Any explicitly constructed bounded-width decomposition of I_sigma is immediately a common layout for all three layers. Conversely any explicitly constructed common layout is a decomposition of I_sigma with at most triple width.

theorem_B_conditional.name: COMMON_LAYOUT_D1_BOUND_V1
theorem_B_conditional.hypothesis: A common decomposition T satisfies mim_{I_{sigma,i}}(e)<=w for every cut e and every i in {1,2,3}.
theorem_B_conditional.external_lemma_import: For any cut A with mim(A)<=w, every vertex subset X on one side has a representative R subset X of size <=w with the same external neighborhood.
theorem_B_conditional.one_set_count: Hence the number of 1-neighborhood equivalence classes for one processed survivor subset is at most sum_{j=0}^w binom(n,j)=n^{O(w)}.
theorem_B_conditional.color_layer_count: For each of 3 auxiliary layers and each of 4 actual colors, retain the 1-neighborhood class of processed vertices in that layer receiving that actual color. This is at most 12 sets (and at most 9 can be nonempty for one fixed 3-list class).
theorem_B_conditional.joint_bound_per_sigma: At most (sum_{j=0}^w binom(n,j))^12 = n^{O(12w)} joint neighborhood signatures.
theorem_B_conditional.all_coarse_classes_bound: Across at most B(s)=9*2^(s+3*2^(2s)) B0 coarse classes, a conservative product bound is n^{O(12*w*B(s))}.
theorem_B_conditional.component_mask_absorption: For every external component-node and actual color c, the d=1 signature records whether it sees at least one processed neighbor of color c; therefore the survivor-induced forbidden-color mask F(C) subseteq {1,2,3,4} is determined without storing one independent 4-bit mask per component.
theorem_B_conditional.firewall: This is only a boundary-signature counting theorem. It does not prove that equal signatures preserve internal Y0-component feasibility, other source objects, or global reconstruction.

phase_A1_reduction.previous_question: Find one common cut tree simultaneously good for the three layers.
phase_A1_reduction.reduced_question: Construct a bounded-mim-width branch decomposition of the single bipartite incidence-union graph I_sigma.
phase_A1_reduction.relation_to_Q_sigma: I_sigma is obtained from the sealed P7-free full quotient Q_sigma by deleting all survivor-survivor edges.
phase_A1_reduction.probe_interpretation: Thus I_sigma is a partitioned probe P7-free graph with non-probe side S_sigma and completion edges G[S_sigma].
phase_A1_reduction.warning: General probe P_t-free structure is not enough for bounded mim-width or coloring tractability; source/B0 restrictions remain essential.

simultaneous_2026_subcheck.reason: The theorem concerns one graph represented by a bounded-mim base graph plus constant labels. No such constant-label representation of I_sigma over a bounded-mim base class has been proved. The available abstract explicitly certifies mim-width, not sim-width.
